name: KH1FM Dual Wield Prototype v4

runtime_scope.ground_and_air: ability-free Valor base rows; ground hop rows excluded
runtime_scope.visual_fallback: current native KH1 pose when a donor or phase match is unavailable
runtime_scope.jump_clock: one Valor jump across paired KH1 takeoff/rise, accounting for native clip rates
runtime_scope.ledge_alignment: native hand midpoint, bounded to 120 units, current actor generation and game frame
runtime_scope.casting: default native KH1 animations and spell logic on ground and in air
runtime_scope.grip: v3 hand-local axes and native right-grip calibration retained
runtime_scope.weapon: duplicate currently equipped KH1 weapon; no second selection or inventory claim
runtime_scope.appearance: native Sora model/textures/colours; matching animation poses only
runtime_scope.contacts: both blades by default; offhand_only_test isolates left imported ground/air melee
runtime_scope.trail: existing per-hand attack windows and retirement retained; no enemy required for swing trail
runtime_scope.pose: exact actor-instance identity and actor-anchored placement; non-attack donor root removed

limitations: No local KH2 install: optional real-data tests did not exercise data paths.
Windows DLL cross-compiled on Linux and not executed inside KH1 here.
Donor availability and visible animation blends require a fresh-process game test.
Palm placement, jump/landing, ledge/glide transitions and map/weapon changes need gameplay verification.
Unknown or unsupported actions stay native; numeric slots are not assigned speculative donors.
Existing contact geometry uses Valor data; different KH1 weapon lengths still need gameplay validation.
Older Dual Wield/offhand systems, embedded duplicate model assets and full combat overhaul must be disabled.
